description:
Show what's in the local Garmin cache and the progress of the current or last sync.

Returns: the running/last sync (progress, errors), and per data domain the date range covered, number of days, whether all history is in, and the last successful sync.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_sync_status
title: Garmin sync status
